import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_79/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_79/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_79/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source tables vertically
Target3_79 = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
Target3_79 = Target3_79.astype({
    'fixed acidity': float,
    'volatile acidity': float,
    'citric acid': float,
    'residual sugar': float,
    'chlorides': float,
    'free sulfur dioxide': int,
    'total sulfur dioxide': int,
    'density': float,
    'pH': float,
    'sulphates': float,
    'alcohol': float,
    'quality': int
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
Target3_79.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_79/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
